objective: Test a projected-addressed RWKV hybrid whose recurrent modulation is controlled by a trainable query/state gate before separately supervised causal training.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: Route agreement passed every training gate and strongly beat zero recurrence, but its fresh held-out donor-minus-correct mean CE was -0.00007892565780798222, so generation remained blocked.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Retain projected addressing but replace the fixed route-overlap abstention rule with a trainable token gate over the current query representation and its projected-addressed RWKV read. Train the gate later with correct-versus-zero, donor, and layer-permuted causal supervision.

architecture.addressing: The frozen projected key/value slot route selects the corresponding recurrent RWKV state slots.
architecture.fusion_equation: projected_read * (1 + 0.125 * gate * direction), where direction = tanh(projected_addressed_rwkv_read / rms(projected_addressed_rwkv_read))
architecture.recurrent_role: bounded elementwise controller admitted by a trainable token-level query/state gate
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: A zero recurrent state produces zero direction, so fusion is exactly projected-only regardless of the gate.
architecture.training_boundary: This screen performs no optimization. A pass authorizes a separately locked causal run that directly supervises correct-state preference and gate abstention.

causal_conditions.projected_only: Correct-row projected carrier with recurrent readout bypassed.
causal_conditions.correct_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus query-gated addressed recurrent readout.
causal_conditions.zero_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus zero recurrent state.
causal_conditions.matched_donor_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus a deterministic different-gold, length-matched donor recurrent state; the query/state gate is recomputed.
causal_conditions.layer_permuted_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus correct recurrence cyclically moved across all 42 wrapped layers; the query/state gate is recomputed.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately locked supervised causal training run with a new source/donor-disjoint open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and test a bounded mixture-of-experts recurrent controller.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the unused strength holdout.

claim_policy.pass: May claim only BF16-visible bounded structural sensitivity before training.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden without later held-out causal preference and a separately locked native generation result.
